The status endpoint accepts only the value Completed. Open and In Progress are set through the edit form, not through this endpoint. The task list shows the new status only after the backend confirms the change.","business_value":"Users can track finished work and the report can count Completed tasks.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task with status Open or In Progress exists","when":"the user marks the task as Completed","then":"the backend stores the status Completed and the task list shows the task with status Completed"},{"given":"the status change request for an existing task fails in the backend","when":"the frontend receives the failure","then":"the task list still shows the previous status and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is pending and the backend has not responded yet","when":"the task list is displayed","then":"the row still shows the previous status and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is sent for a task ID that does not exist","when":"the backend processes the request","then":"the backend returns a task not found error and no stored task changes"},{"given":"a status change request is sent with a status value other than Completed, including Open or In Progress","when":"the backend validates the request","then":"the backend rejects the request with an invalid input error and the stored status does not change"},{"given":"a task is marked as Completed","when":"the backend saves the change","then":"the Completion Date field of the task is populated with the time of the change"}],"edge_cases":["Marking a task that is already Completed as Completed again: the PRD does not say whether the Completion Date is kept or reset;
